busyCalls.question: Can Ringlume answer calls when we're busy or unavailable?
busyCalls.paragraph1: Yes. Ringlume answers 24/7, including when your team is busy, on-site, or off the clock.

urgentCalls.question: Can Ringlume handle urgent calls?
urgentCalls.paragraph1: It can flag urgent business requests and contact your team using your rules. It is not an emergency service.

professionalExpertise.question: What happens when a caller needs professional expertise?
professionalExpertise.paragraph1: Ringlume collects the details and books a visit or transfers the call. It does not replace professional judgment.

appointments.question: Can Ringlume book appointments automatically?
appointments.paragraph1: Yes. It checks your connected calendar and books appointments using your availability and scheduling rules.

leadInformation.question: What information can Ringlume collect from a new lead?
leadInformation.paragraph1: You choose what to collect, such as:

businessQuestions.question: Can Ringlume answer questions about our business and services?
businessQuestions.paragraph1: Yes. It uses your approved services, hours, service areas, prices, and FAQs.

pricingQuestions.question: What if customers ask about pricing?
pricingQuestions.paragraph1: It shares approved prices or books an estimate. It should not guess.

differentServices.question: Can Ringlume handle different services or types of inquiries?
differentServices.paragraph1: Yes. Set different questions, booking steps, and handoff rules for each service you offer.

unknownAnswer.question: What happens if Ringlume doesn't know the answer?
unknownAnswer.paragraph1: It can take a message or hand the call to your team instead of guessing.

liveTransfer.question: Can important calls be transferred to a real person?
liveTransfer.paragraph1: Yes. When enabled, it transfers calls to your team using the rules you choose.

callFollowUp.question: Will we know what happened after every call?
callFollowUp.paragraph1: Yes. Call summaries, recordings, and caller details are available on all plans through your dashboard.

receptionistStaff.question: Does Ringlume replace my receptionist or office staff?
receptionistStaff.paragraph1: It handles routine phone calls, not in-person duties. Use it alongside your team or for overflow calls.

services.paragraph1Text1: Ringlume provides virtual receptionist and automated call-handling services for businesses, including but not limited to:
services.item1Text1: Virtual receptionist services for inbound and outbound call handling
services.item2Text1: Automated appointment scheduling and calendar management
services.item4Text1: Call summaries, transcripts, and reporting dashboards
services.item5Text1: Setup using your business information and call-handling preferences
services.item6Text1: Integration services for customer management systems, SMS, email, and third-party platforms
services.paragraph2Text1: The specific features, capabilities, and scope of the Services are detailed in your active subscription plan and may be updated or modified by Ringlume from time to time to improve functionality and service quality.
services.paragraph3Text1: Every plan includes a User Dashboard and daily call recordings and reports. Web calls and web chat widgets are also included on all plans; usage charges are governed by
services.paragraph3Text3: . Agent bundles, included call minutes and phone numbers, simultaneous-call limits, calendar and CRM connections, multilingual support, and support levels are set out in the
services.paragraph4Text1: Your phone setup, calendar, CRM, and any special compliance requirements are reviewed before setup. Custom integrations depend on the tools and agreed scope. No compliance certification or regulated workflow is guaranteed by choosing a plan. Preferred tools and launch estimates are explained in
services.paragraph5Text1: HIPAA support and a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) are available on all plans through Trillet. Use involving protected health information requires confirmation of the applicable BAA, configuration, and agreed scope before processing begins.

billing.paragraph1Text1: Ringlume offers four subscription plans: {planNames}. Each plan is available with monthly or annual billing. The subscription fee and billing interval are the amounts and terms shown on the Ringlume Pricing page at the time of purchase.
billing.paragraph2Text1: Subscription charges renew automatically at the selected billing interval until cancelled. Customers can manage or cancel a subscription by contacting us through our Contact page, and we confirm the cancellation timing and effective date before the change takes effect.
billing.paragraph3Text1: A one-time Service Setup Fee applies when shown on the Ringlume Pricing page. It is displayed before payment and is charged with the initial transaction; it is not a recurring subscription charge. Applicable taxes are calculated and displayed before payment.
billing.paragraph4Text1: All fees are quoted in United States Dollars (USD) unless otherwise specified. Our payment provider processes payment and billing records for Ringlume and provides invoices or receipts, payment-method management, and hosted billing tools. Ringlume manually sets up and manages the Services, including the dashboard access included with every plan.
billing.paragraph5Text2: All fees, including subscription charges and the one-time Service Setup Fee, are non-refundable, except where a refund is required by applicable law.
billing.subheading1Text1: 3.1 Usage Rates, Annual Billing, and Plan Changes
billing.paragraph6Text1: Included minutes reset monthly. Extra call-minute rates are
billing.paragraph6Text2: . Annual subscriptions are charged at the full annual total shown on the Pricing page; displayed monthly equivalents are approximate, not monthly charges.
billing.item3Text2: . These carrier charges apply to calls routed through a phone number in addition to standard call usage.
billing.item4Text2: per additional number per month, beyond the numbers included in your plan.
billing.paragraph7Text1: Voice conversations through a website widget or web call use the same monthly call-minute allowance and standard per-minute rates as phone calls, including your plan's additional-minute rate once the allowance is exhausted. Web calls do not use a phone line, so no telephony fee applies. This exemption does not make web-call usage free.
billing.paragraph8Text1: Text messages exchanged through the web chat widget are counted as SMS messages for billing purposes and charged at your plan's SMS rate. In a type-or-talk session, where a visitor switches between typing and speaking, the voice portion is billed as call usage and the typed messages are billed at SMS rates. Including a widget in your plan does not waive these usage charges.
billing.paragraph9Text1: Request upgrades or cancellation through our
billing.paragraph9Text3: . Upgrades are charged at the prorated difference for the rest of the current billing period. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. We confirm changes by email.
billing.paragraph10Text1: The missed-call calculator multiplies missed calls per week by the assumed booking rate, booking value, repeat-visit multiplier, and 52 weeks. Monthly estimates divide that result by 12. These are illustrative assumptions, not promised bookings or revenue. Actual recovered revenue depends on call volume, lead quality, scheduling capacity, and other factors.
billing.paragraph11Text1: The wage comparison divides the cited U.S. annual median receptionist wage by 12 and rounds to the nearest dollar. Wages exclude benefits and payroll taxes and do not cover 24/7 staffing. Ringlume handles phone calls and scheduling, not in-person reception or every administrative duty. This comparison does not guarantee savings.
billing.paragraph12Text1: When you upgrade, the total Service Setup Fees already paid count toward the new plan's Service Setup Fee. This includes your initial setup payment and any setup-fee top-ups paid on earlier upgrades. You pay only the remaining difference, not the full setup fee again. If your previous setup payments already cover the new plan's setup fee, no additional setup fee is due.
billing.paragraph13Text1: This setup-fee credit is separate from subscription charges and any prorated subscription difference due when upgrading.

privacy.metaDescription: How Ringlume collects, processes, stores, and protects data used for automated call-handling, including call records, voice transcripts, and contact information.

introduction.paragraph1Text1: Ringlume ("Company," "we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, store, and safeguard your personal information and data when you use our virtual receptionist and automated call-handling and voice-processing technology, plus all related software, platforms, and communication tools (collectively, the "Services").
introduction.paragraph2Text1: By using the Services, you consent to the collection and processing of your data as described in this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with our data practices, please discontinue use of the Services immediately.

informationCollected.paragraph1Text1: We collect various categories of information to provide and improve our Services:
informationCollected.item1Text1: Information provided for service setup or support, such as your name, email address, business name, and phone number
informationCollected.item2Text1: Billing and payment information processed through our payment provider, such as billing address and transaction details. Ringlume does not receive your full card number.
informationCollected.item3Text1: Business documents uploaded to set up the service with information about your business
informationCollected.item4Text1: Communications sent to us via email, WhatsApp, or other channels
informationCollected.item5Text1: Website usage data (pages visited, time spent, click patterns, device information)
informationCollected.item6Text1: IP addresses and approximate geolocation data
informationCollected.item7Text1: Browser type, operating system, and device identifiers
informationCollected.item9Text1: Telephone call recordings (both inbound and outbound)
informationCollected.item10Text1: Complete voice transcripts and conversation logs
informationCollected.item11Text1: Caller identification information (phone numbers, caller ID data)
informationCollected.item12Text1: Call metadata (duration, timestamps, call outcome, transfer status)
informationCollected.item13Text1: Sentiment analysis results and emotional context indicators
informationCollected.item14Text1: Appointment and scheduling data extracted from calls
informationCollected.item15Text1: Customer records synchronized through connected integrations
informationCollected.item16Text1: Contact information imported from third-party platforms
informationCollected.item17Text1: Calendar and scheduling data from connected calendar services

dataUse.paragraph1Text1: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
dataUse.item1Text2: To provide, operate, maintain, and improve the virtual receptionist and related automated call-handling services
dataUse.item2Text2: To set up how the service handles calls using your business-specific data and improve response accuracy and conversation quality
dataUse.item3Text2: To record, transcribe, analyze, and store telephone communications processed through the Services
dataUse.item4Text2: To schedule, confirm, and manage appointments based on caller interactions
dataUse.item5Text2: To generate post-call reports, performance analytics, and business reports
dataUse.item6Text2: To trigger SMS confirmations, email notifications, customer-record updates, and follow-up sequences
dataUse.item7Text2: To respond to inquiries, troubleshoot issues, and provide technical assistance
dataUse.item8Text2: To comply with applicable laws, regulations, and legal processes
dataUse.item9Text2: To detect, prevent, and address fraud, unauthorized access, and other malicious activity

storageSecurity.paragraph1Text1: We implement enterprise-grade security measures to protect your data, including:
storageSecurity.item1Text2: All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3 and at rest using AES-256 encryption standards
storageSecurity.item2Text2: Data is stored on SOC 2 Type II-compliant cloud infrastructure with redundant backups
storageSecurity.item3Text2: Strict role-based access controls ensure only authorized personnel can access sensitive data
storageSecurity.item4Text2: We conduct regular security assessments and penetration testing to identify and address vulnerabilities
storageSecurity.item5Text2: We maintain a comprehensive incident response plan to address any security breaches promptly
storageSecurity.paragraph2Text1: While we implement robust security measures, no method of electronic transmission or storage is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security but will promptly notify affected users in the event of a data breach as required by applicable law.

callRecording.paragraph1Text1: Our automated call-handling and voice-processing service records and transcribes telephone conversations for the following purposes:
callRecording.item1Text1: Quality checks and ongoing improvement of response accuracy
callRecording.item2Text1: Training data used to improve how the service understands callers and generates responses
callRecording.item5Text1: Automated follow-up actions after calls (SMS confirmations, customer-record updates, etc.)
callRecording.paragraph2Text1: Call recordings and their associated transcripts are stored securely and are accessible exclusively through the Client dashboard. Recordings are retained for the duration of the active subscription and for a period of ninety (90) days following subscription termination, after which they are permanently deleted unless retention is required by applicable law.
callRecording.paragraph3Text2: The Client is solely responsible for ensuring compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local call recording consent laws in their jurisdiction. Ringlume provides tools that automatically tell callers when a call may be recorded but assumes no liability for the Client's compliance with recording consent requirements.

dataSharing.paragraph1Text1: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for their marketing purposes. We may share your data in the following limited circumstances:
dataSharing.item1Text2: With trusted third-party vendors who assist in operating our Services, including cloud hosting, telecommunications providers, and our payment provider for payment processing and billing, bound by applicable data processing obligations
dataSharing.item2Text2: When required by law, subpoena, court order, or governmental regulation
dataSharing.item3Text2: In connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, with prior notice to affected users
dataSharing.item4Text2: When you explicitly authorize data sharing with specific third parties through the platform settings

dataRights.paragraph1Text1: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:
dataRights.item1Text2: Request a copy of all personal data we hold about you
dataRights.item2Text2: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
dataRights.item3Text2: Request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal retention requirements
dataRights.item4Text2: Request a machine-readable copy of your data for transfer to another service
dataRights.item5Text2: Request restriction of processing in certain circumstances
dataRights.item6Text2: Object to processing based on legitimate interests
dataRights.item7Text2: Withdraw previously given consent at any time
dataRights.paragraph2Text1: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at support@ringlume.com. We will respond to your request within thirty (30) days.

retention.paragraph1Text1: We retain your data for as long as necessary to provide the Services and fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Policy:
retention.item1Text2: Retained for the duration of the active subscription plus 90 days
retention.item2Text2: Retained for the duration of the active subscription plus 90 days
retention.item3Text2: Our payment provider retains payment records, and Ringlume retains billing records it receives, for seven (7) years where required by tax and financial regulations
retention.item4Text2: Aggregated and anonymized data may be retained indefinitely for service improvement

cookies.paragraph1Text1: Our website and third-party payment or billing tools may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to support functionality and enhance your experience:
cookies.item1Text2: Required for basic website functionality and security
cookies.item2Text2: Help us understand how visitors interact with our website
cookies.paragraph2Text1: You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may affect website functionality.

children.paragraph1Text1: Our Services are not directed to individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you become aware that a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us immediately, and we will take steps to delete such information.

policyChanges.paragraph1Text1: We reserve the right to update or modify this Privacy Policy at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting on this page with an updated revision date. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically. Your continued use of the Services after any changes constitutes acceptance of the updated Privacy Policy.

contact.paragraph1Text1: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:
